name: GardenSalesItemEnumProbe
source: public class GardenSalesItemEnumProbe { public List<CartExtension.SalesItemTypeEnum> values() { return CartExtension.SalesItemTypeEnum.values(); } public CartExtension.SalesItemTypeEnum product() { return CartExtension.SalesItemTypeEnum.valueOf('PRODUCT'); } }

name: GardenCartItemProbe
source: public class GardenCartItemProbe { public CartExtension.CartItem create(CartExtension.CartDeliveryGroup deliveryGroup) { return new CartExtension.CartItem(CartExtension.SalesItemTypeEnum.PRODUCT, deliveryGroup, 'Garden item'); } public CartExtension.SalesItemTypeEnum typeOf(CartExtension.CartItem item) { return item.getType(); } }

name: GardenListConstructorProbe
source: public class GardenListConstructorProbe { public CartExtension.CartItemList create() { return new CartExtension.CartItemList(); } }

name: GardenListCallsProbe
source: public class GardenListCallsProbe { public void use(CartExtension.Cart cart, CartExtension.CartDeliveryGroup deliveryGroup) { CartExtension.CartItemList items = cart.getCartItems(); Iterator<CartExtension.CartItem> itemIterator = items.iterator(); CartExtension.CartItem item = itemIterator.next(); items.add(deliveryGroup); items.remove(deliveryGroup); items.clear(); } }

name: GardenListCommerceArgumentProbe
source: public class GardenListCommerceArgumentProbe { public void use(CartExtension.CartItemList items, CartExtension.CartDeliveryGroup deliveryGroup) { items.add(deliveryGroup); items.remove(deliveryGroup); } }

name: GardenCommerceObjectProbe62
source: public class GardenCommerceObjectProbe62 { public CartExtension.CommerceObject groupAsCommerce(CartExtension.CartDeliveryGroup deliveryGroup) { return deliveryGroup; } public CartExtension.CommerceObject itemAsCommerce(CartExtension.CartItem item) { return item; } }

name: GardenCartListStringArgument62
source: public class GardenCartListStringArgument62 { public static void appendString(CartExtension.CartItemList items, String value) { items.add(value); items.remove(value); } }

name: GardenListForEachProbe
source: public class GardenListForEachProbe { public Integer count(CartExtension.CartItemList items) { Integer itemCount = 0; for (CartExtension.CartItem item : items) { itemCount++; } return itemCount; } }
